prompt_templates.name: run-status
prompt_templates.description: Inspect an experiment's real progress and blockers.
prompt_templates.content: Inspect the experiment identified by `$1`, or infer the active run from the current context. Do not modify or restart it. Read the live process state, code revision, dataset/model/config identity, checkpoint stage, completed result artifacts, recent error logs, disk/GPU/provider state, and the basis for any ETA. Distinguish scheduled, running, completed, failed, and unknown work. Report observed facts first, then the likely blocker and safest next action; never print credentials.
